QF.id: VII Other Services Provided by Brokers_23

question.text: The minimum investment amount for PMS clients is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the NISM Series VII workbook (page 256), a portfolio manager shall not accept from clients funds or securities worth less than Rs 50 lakhs as the first lump-sum investment. The Trap: The Rs 50 lakhs threshold is the minimum first lump-sum investment. Accredited investors and co-investment portfolio managers are exempt from this minimum. Note: Source: NISM Series VII workbook, page 256.
